title: Passage 25
voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

sentences.en: There are lots of things that cause stress, such as school problems, arguments with friends and bad feelings about ourselves.
sentences.cn: 有很多事情会引起压力，比如学业问题、和朋友的争吵以及对自己的负面情绪。

sentences.en: It's important to manage stress properly and reduce its influence.
sentences.cn: 妥善处理压力并减轻其影响是很重要的。

sentences.en: Here are some helpful tips for dealing with stress.
sentences.cn: 以下是一些应对压力的实用建议。

sentences.en: Do you always wait until Sunday evening to do homework?
sentences.cn: 你是不是总是等到周日晚上才去做作业？

sentences.en: This bad habit can cause last-minute stress, as well as poor grades.
sentences.cn: 这种坏习惯会导致最后一刻的压力，还会让你成绩不佳。

sentences.en: To avoid that, time management is greatly needed.
sentences.cn: 为了避免这种情况，时间管理是非常必要的。

sentences.en: Plan your studies with a calendar.
sentences.cn: 可以用日历来规划你的学习安排。

sentences.en: You can also divide big projects into smaller tasks.
sentences.cn: 你还可以把大项目分解成较小的任务。

sentences.en: Besides, staying organised is very important for reducing stress.
sentences.cn: 此外，保持条理有序对于减轻压力也很重要。

sentences.en: Do the necessary housework.
sentences.cn: 做必要的家务。

sentences.en: Pack your school bag well.
sentences.cn: 收拾好你的书包。

sentences.en: Use your shelves at home to keep things in order.
sentences.cn: 利用家里的架子把东西摆放整齐。

sentences.en: Be sure to eat healthy meals and get at least 8 hours of sleep.
sentences.cn: 一定要吃健康的食物，并保证至少八小时的睡眠。

sentences.en: Avoid checking your mobile phone or using the computer before bedtime.
sentences.cn: 避免在睡前查看手机或使用电脑。

sentences.en: It will keep you awake and make things worse.
sentences.cn: 这样会让你一直睡不着觉，情况会变得更糟。

sentences.en: When you're feeling stressed, it's helpful to speak to someone who understands your situation, such as a friend,
sentences.cn: 当你感到有压力时，向理解你处境的人倾诉是有帮助的，比如朋友、你的丈夫或妻子，或年长的家人。

sentences.en: your husband or wife or an elder family member.
sentences.cn: 当你感到有压力时，向理解你处境的人倾诉是有帮助的，比如朋友、你的丈夫或妻子，或年长的家人。

sentences.en: Sometimes just sharing your feelings is enough.
sentences.cn: 有时，只分享你的感受就足够了。

sentences.en: Other times, however, you might need advice.
sentences.cn: 但还有时，你可能需要建议。

sentences.en: Don't keep your worries to yourself.
sentences.cn: 不要把你的烦恼憋在心里。

sentences.en: Finally, relaxation is important.
sentences.cn: 最后，放松也很重要。

sentences.en: Do simple things like having a warm shower to calm yourself.
sentences.cn: 做一些简单的事情来让自己平静下来，比如洗个热水澡。

sentences.en: Find some free time for activities that you enjoy.
sentences.cn: 找些空闲时间参加自己喜欢的活动。

sentences.en: For example, you can go skating or skiing.
sentences.cn: 例如，你可以去滑冰或滑雪。

sentences.en: Walk in your village or town.
sentences.cn: 在乡村或小镇里散步。

sentences.en: Fly a kite in the park or meet and hang out with friends.
sentences.cn: 在公园里放风筝，或与朋友见面闲逛。

sentences.en: If you relax and enjoy yourself, you'll feel refreshed, have more energy and reduce your level of stress.
sentences.cn: 如果你能放松心情、尽情享受，你就会感到神清气爽，精力充沛，压力水平也会降低。
